journey.name: Warm-up and cool-down
journey.description: Set a warm-up and a cool-down on the Timer, run the workout through both, and save its shape as a preset. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"

Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Conditioning", then tap "Timer" at the top of the presets, and verify that the Timer is shown with a "Start workout" button and a "Warm-up" and a "Cool-down" chip reading "Off"
Verify that a sheet titled "Warm-up" is shown with "Quick picks"
Tap the "Cool-down" chip, tap the "2:00" quick pick, then "Done"
Verify that the chips read "Warm-up 1:00" and "Cool-down 2:00" and the total reads 8:55
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready", then "Warm-up" with "Next: work"
Press Home and verify that the notification reads "Warm-up" without a round
Return to the workout and tap "Skip" until the screen shows "Work" and "Round 8 of 8"
Verify that the screen shows "Next: cool-down"
Tap "Skip" and verify that the screen shows "Cool-down"
Tap "End", then "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the summary says "Saved to your log" and shows 8/8 rounds
Tap "Done", open "All presets" and verify that the Timer row reads "1m warm-up · 30s on · 15s off · ×8 · 2m cool-down" with a "Save as preset" row under it
